description: The semantic-stage half of `core-language/scoping/a-procedure-cannot-see-the-block-that-is-calling-it`. The checker resolves names lexically (spec/execution-model.md:416-424), so the fact that the `repeat` body is still running when it calls `helper` is not a fact it has or needs: `:temp` is bound only by a block scope, which encloses no procedure body, so the read is `ol-undefined-var` and not `ol-var-not-visible` (spec/error-model.md:102,132). The two fixtures together are what keeps issue #825's checker from disagreeing with the runtime about which code this program gets.
